reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getBulkActionCategories helper that every month-wide action already calls, rather than adding a new query.

duplication.why: The hidden rule stays in the single SQL of the shared helper; each action only forwards the flag.

placement.why: The selection rule stays in budget/actions.ts's category-selection helper and handler types still derive from the action signatures in app.ts.

scope.why: Only the helper, the six month-wide actions' signatures and two focused tests change.

maintainability.why: A named BulkActionOptions type and one parameterised predicate are easy to own; the six identical destructure-and-forward edits are minor boilerplate.
